text='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full line barrier and the non-background object.
    rowbar = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])), None)
    colbar = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] and grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))), None)
    # Background is the most frequent color other than the barrier.
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    barrier_color = grid[rowbar][0] if rowbar is not None else grid[0][colbar]
    bg = max((v for v in freq if v != barrier_color), key=lambda v: freq[v])
    obj = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, barrier_color)}
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # retain barrier
    if rowbar is not None: out[rowbar] = grid[rowbar][:]
    else:
        for r in range(h): out[r][colbar] = barrier_color
    if rowbar is not None:
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in obj), max(r for r,c in obj)
        if rowbar < lo: dr = rowbar + 1 - hi
        else: dr = rowbar - 1 - lo
        moved = {(r+dr,c) for r,c in obj}
        stripe = min(r for r,c in moved)-1 if dr < 0 else max(r for r,c in moved)+1
        if 0 <= stripe < h: out[stripe] = [8]*w
    else:
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in obj), max(c for r,c in obj)
        if colbar < lo: dc = colbar + 1 - hi
        else: dc = colbar - 1 - lo
        moved = {(r,c+dc) for r,c in obj}
        stripe = min(c for r,c in moved)-1 if dc < 0 else max(c for r,c in moved)+1
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][stripe] = 8
    for r,c in moved: out[r][c] = grid[r-dr if rowbar is not None else r][c if rowbar is not None else c-dc]
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full line barrier and the non-background object.
    rowbar = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and sum(row.count(grid[r][0]) for row in grid) == w), None)
    colbar = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0 and sum(row.count(grid[0][c]) for row in grid) == h), None)
    # Background is the most frequent color other than the barrier.
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    barrier_color = grid[rowbar][0] if rowbar is not None else grid[0][colbar]
    bg = max((v for v in freq if v != barrier_color), key=lambda v: freq[v])
    obj = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, barrier_color)}
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # retain barrier
    if rowbar is not None: out[rowbar] = grid[rowbar][:]
    else:
        for r in range(h): out[r][colbar] = barrier_color
    if rowbar is not None:
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in obj), max(r for r,c in obj)
        if rowbar < lo: dr = rowbar + 1 - lo
        else: dr = rowbar - 1 - hi
        moved = {(r+dr,c) for r,c in obj}
        stripe = min(r for r,c in moved)-1 if dr < 0 else max(r for r,c in moved)+1
        if 0 <= stripe < h: out[stripe] = [8]*w
    else:
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in obj), max(c for r,c in obj)
        if colbar < lo: dc = colbar + 1 - lo
        else: dc = colbar - 1 - hi
        moved = {(r,c+dc) for r,c in obj}
        stripe = min(c for r,c in moved)-1 if dc < 0 else max(c for r,c in moved)+1
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][stripe] = 8
    for r,c in moved: out[r][c] = grid[r-dr if rowbar is not None else r][c if rowbar is not None else c-dc]
    return out
